description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView Adapter (`ContentRowAdapter`) for rendering a list of content rows, each containing a title and a horizontal list of content cards. It manages focus behavior to ensure titles are visible when content cards gain focus, preventing clipping issues in a TV-like interface.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: Adapter that renders a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontal list of content cards.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for a content row, managing the row's title and inner RecyclerView of content cards.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for a content row and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow object to the ViewHolder, setting up the title and inner RecyclerView with focus handling.
